proposition: Akhlāṭī was a physician by trade and resident alchemist and wonderworker at Sultan Barqūq's court, known for mastery of jafr, raml, ḥurūf and taksīr; a later Shiraz manuscript of Gāzurgāhī shows him receiving gifts from Barqūq.

mediation.who: Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr editor's introduction and Gāzurgāhī's Majālis al-ʿUshshāq (painting ca. 1560)
